decisive_items: RIPE (rifampin, isoniazid, pyrazinamide, ethambutol) nine months earlier
serum testing revealed an ANA titer of 1:160 with a speckled pattern
response.rationale: Recurrent lymphocytic exudative pleural effusions arising while taking isoniazid-containing RIPE, with a positive serum ANA and absence of mycobacterial confirmation, favor drug-induced lupus. Paradoxical TB is undermined by repeatedly negative cultures, low ADA, and no granulomata; SLE is less likely given negative pleural fluid ANA and only low-titer serum ANA without other systemic features.

rejected.why: Paradoxical TB effusion is unsupported by persistent culture negativity, low ADA, negative QuantiFERON, and non-granulomatous biopsies; worsening effusions on anti-TB therapy are atypical.
Pleural fluid ANA was negative, serum ANA titer was only 1:160 speckled, and the clinical picture is better explained by a medication-induced lupus rather than spontaneous SLE.
